subject: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Rivera <daniel@primeride.co>, SFO Valet Services <contact@sfo-valet.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Hi Daniel, SFO Valet team —

We have an executive workshop at SFO on Sept 14 (50 guests arriving in four waves). I need PrimeRide to provide:
- Six sedans (black, non-logo) from 7:30–12:30 and a backup sedan pool for late arrivals
- Driver credentialing (photo ID + driver license copy), proof of commercial insurance, and a COVID/cleaning protocol summary to share with Acme
- A documented arrival window handoff procedure for curbside staging and two reserved valet spots at Arrivals Zone C (see attached map)

Kimberly and Marcus — can you confirm Redwood's on-site badge process and whether we can pre-provision temporary parking passes for two vendor vehicles?

Attaching: ride_manifest_v2.xlsx (guest list with pickup windows), valet_zone_map_SFO.pdf

Next steps I'd like this week:
1) Daniel: updated quote and a short vendor credential packet by Tue 24 Aug
2) SFO Valet: confirmation on reserving two spaces and any rate/permit requirements
3) Kimberly/Marcus: confirmation on badge access for driver liaisons and a point of contact for check-in

Thanks — aim is to have everything vendor-approved and signed by Sept 1 so procurement can run the PO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Events | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Daniel Rivera <daniel@primeride.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: SFO Valet Services <contact@sfo-valet.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Marissa —

Thanks for the details and the manifest. Attached is our updated quote (PrimeRide_quote_v2.pdf). A few clarifications:
- Driver packets: we can provide a one-page vendor credential packet (insurance cert, recent driver MVR summary, vehicle IDs, masked SSN not included) by EOD Tue 24 Aug
- Backup pool: we recommend keeping two on-call sedans staged 15 minutes away to avoid long wait times during wave 3
- Clean protocol: drivers will perform high-touch surface wipes between each trip and carry sealed PPE kits; we can add in-vehicle HEPA filters on request

Quick ask — does Acme require drivers to be background-checked through a specific vendor or is PrimeRide’s standard screening sufficient?

I'll send the credential packet and the signed service terms once we confirm the permit logistics with SFO Valet.

Best,
Daniel Rivera
Operations Lead | PrimeRide Logistics
daniel@primeride.co | +1 (650) 555-2124

Attachment: PrimeRide_quote_v2.pdf

---

From: SFO Valet Services <contact@sfo-valet.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Daniel Rivera <daniel@primeride.co>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Hi Marissa and team,

We can reserve two cleared spaces in Arrivals Zone C for Sept 14 between 7:00–13:00. Permit: $120 per vehicle (one-day), payable via invoice. Please provide vehicle plate numbers and driver names 48 hours prior to event; we will issue temporary placards for expedited curb access.

Note: if any vehicle is commercial-livery (logo or decals), it will need to use Service Lane B for drop-off — otherwise Arrivals Zone C is fine for sedans without branding.

Regards,
SFO Valet Services Operations
contact@sfo-valet.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Rivera <daniel@primeride.co>, SFO Valet Services <contact@sfo-valet.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Thanks all —

Kimberly: please confirm temporary badge provisioning. Marcus: can you handle logging driver credential packets in our audit folder? Laura: would you own the two-point check (badge + ID) at staging? Ideally we pre-seed the manifest into our check-in tablet.

Daniel: Acme's procurement said standard background screening plus commercial insurance is acceptable; they did ask for a scanned driver license and a recent MVR (we will treat driver license scans as sensitive PII and delete after the event). Please include redaction guidance in your packet if you have it.

I'll route the PO once the quote and credential packet are in — procurement needs vendor tax id and W-9 as well.

Marissa

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Marissa — confirmed. Temporary visitor badges for driver liaisons can be issued at Security Desk A with pre-registration. Marcus — please drop the credential packet into /Shared/Events/Acme/DriverPackets once Daniel sends it; Security will pull from there. Laura will staff the staging table from 7:00–13:30.

Also flagged: we'll need an internal liaison to escort drivers through Service Lane B if any vehicle shows a logo; happy to have Jonas cover that day.

Kimberly Park
Head of Workplace Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Rivera <daniel@primeride.co>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — vehicle vetting, parking passes, and on-site credentialing

Got it — I'll create the event folder and place an empty ride_manifest_v2.xlsx template so Security can pre-load names. Daniel: once you send driver packets (DL scan + MVR redacted per Marissa), I'll log them and mark a status column (received/cleared).

Daniel — two quick asks before I close the loop with procurement: can you send the vendor tax id and a W-9 in the credential packet, and confirm whether PrimeRide will accept a net-30 PO? If yes, I'll attach that to the procurement request.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Compliance Analyst | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
